description: Carrier delivery date — Estimated delivery date for a shipment from ship date and transit days, using each carrier's delivery days and holiday closures (USPS Mon-Sat with all federal holidays; UPS, FedEx, DHL, LTL Mon-Fri with 6 major holidays and modified-service days). carrier=usps|ups|fedex|dhl|ltl|all, optional ship=YYYY-MM-DD (default today), saturday=true, cutoff=HH:MM with tz=. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: logistics_delivery_date
